info.title: GrowBook garden API
info.summary: Read-only, paginated access to the garden registers, plantings and diary.
info.description: Every endpoint is read-only and requires a bearer token issued to the account that owns it. Text is returned exactly as it was stored, and a null value means it was never recorded.
